Metadata.title: Naora · online booking with a Pix deposit
Metadata.description: Online booking for salons, barbershops and studios: clients pick a time from a link and hold it with a Pix deposit.

Home.title: A full calendar, fewer no-shows, and less time on WhatsApp.
Home.lead: Naora is online booking for anyone who works by appointment. Clients pick a time from a link and hold it with a Pix deposit that goes straight to your account. You see the day and what came in, in one place.
Home.step1: You share your link on Instagram or WhatsApp.
Home.step2: Your client picks a service and a free time.
Home.step3: They pay a Pix deposit, and the time is held for both of you.
Home.ctaText: Sign in with a one-click demo account: create a business page, add a service and book as if you were the client. In the demo the Pix is simulated and nothing is charged.
Home.plansLead: Start without paying anything. When your calendar fills up, Pro costs less.
Home.questions: Questions, or want help getting started? <email>Send me an email</email>.

Footer.built: Built in public by Rayssa Roberta.
